description: Keep-it-fixed rails (SYNAPSE-HANDOUT §4.4): security updates land as auto-PRs immediately; everything else arrives as weekly PRs for triage. Nothing automerges except security patch-level bumps, so every capability-affecting change still crosses the human gate.

packageRules.description: Security and patch-level bumps: open immediately, automerge only patch; minor/major security bumps still need review because they can change behavior (INV-S1).
Vulnerability-driven updates skip the weekly schedule.
All non-security updates: weekly batch, no automerge.
